title: Ukrainian Ricotta Kissed Casserole
description: A Ukrainian-inspired casserole featuring ricotta cheese, with a hint of citrusy flavors.

ingredients.name: And
ingredients.amount: 1/2 cup, chopped fresh herbs (such as parsley or dill)

ingredients.name: Citrusy zest
ingredients.amount: 1 tablespoon, freshly grated lemon or orange zest

instructions: In a large bowl, combine ricotta cheese, kissed tomatoes, and citrusy zest. Mix well.
In a separate bowl, mix together Ukrainian black bread and casserole cheese blend.
Add the bread mixture to the ricotta mixture and stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the casserole is hot and the cheese is melted.
Sprinkle with chopped fresh herbs (such as parsley or dill) before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with additional herbs if desired.
